crossRefs.note: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
“Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is…
Heal the sick who are there, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

translations.web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
translations.bsb: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.”
translations.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
translations.asv: neither shall they say, Lo, here! or, There! for lo, the kingdom of God is within you.
